day_local: Xusidda Saint Martin ee Tours, Bishop
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbiga, oo ah kan ina jecel, ha idinla jirto idin wada jirta.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu waa daajiyahayga; waxba iima dhimna.
homily:
Bal ka fikir adigoo taagan garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaarad weyn oo Boeing 737 ah oo si tartiib ah u soo dagaysa, iyadoo iftiinka qorraxdu uu ka dhex muuqdo muraayadaheeda. Waxaa jira wax aad u qurux badan oo ku saabsan sida ay diyaaraddu ula jaanqaadayso hawada, sida ay u raacdo wadada loo jeexay, iyo sida ay ugu dambayntii u degto meeshii loogu talagalay. Waxaa jira xasilooni ku jirta qofka garanaya meesha uu u socdo, xitaa marka daruuruhu ay adag yihiin. Maanta, Saint Martin ee Tours, oo ah nin qarniyo ka hor nolosha u bixiyay si uu u muujiyo naxariista Masiixa, wuxuu inoo xasuusinayaa in nolosheennu ay tahay safar. Safar aan keligeen ku socon, balse uu Rabbigu inoo hoggaaminayo.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheekada tobankii bukooday ee uu Ciise bogsiiyay. Toban nin oo cudurkaas darteed ka fogeeyay bulshada, ka fogeeyay qoysaskooda, oo taagan meel fog. Waxay ku qaylinayaan: 'Ciise, Macallimow! Naxariiso noo yeelo!' Ciise wuxuu u sheegay inay tagaan oo ay naftooda u muujiyaan wadaaddada. Intay socdeen, way bogsadeen. Laakiin mid ka mid ah, markuu ogaaday inuu bogsaday, wuxuu ku soo noqday isagoo Ilaah ku ammaanaya cod dheer, wuxuuna ku dhacay cagaha Ciise si uu ugu mahadceliyo. Waxaana la inoo sheegay inuu ahaa nin Samaariyaan ah—shisheeye. Ciise wuxuu weydiiyay: 'Toban ayaa la bogsiiyay, miyaanay ahayn? Meeye sagaalkii kale?'

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil ay maskaxdiisu u duulaysay sidii diyaaradaha uu aadka u jeclaa. Waxaad ogtihiin inuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya ku mashquulin xisaabta iyo tiknoolajiyadda, balse ahaa wiil leh indho wax arka oo fog. Waxaa ka mid ahaa waxyaabihii uu aad u jeclaa shimbiraha iyo riyadiisa ahayd inuu maalin maalmaha ka mid ah abuuro shirkad diyaaradeed oo uu ugu yeero 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayey 'con chim airlines', wuxuu si tartiib ah u dhoola caddayn jiray, iyadoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan farxad iyo riyooyin nadiif ah. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u furan mahadcelinta, qalbi u furan inuu dadka kale u naxariisto.

Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta si gaar ah u taabto hal xaqiiqo. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dareentaan sida sagaalkii nin ee kale ee aan soo noqon—ma aha sababtoo ah waad mahadcelin la'dahay, balse sababtoo ah xanuunka, murugada, iyo culeyska afartaan bilood ayaa idin qariyay. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad dareemaysaan in nolosha ay idin ka fogaysay, sida uu cudurku u fogeeyay tobankii nin. Laakiin fiiri ninka Samaariyaanka ah. Wuxuu ku soo noqday isagoo jilbaha u dhigay Ciise. Maanta, waxaan idinku dhiirigelinayaa inaad jilbaha u dhigtaan Ciise, xitaa haddii aysan jirin wax kale oo aad tiraahdaan marka laga reebo, 'Rabbiyow, waan ku xanuunsanahay, laakiin waan ku aaminsanahay.'

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay inaan maanta halkan u joogin inaan fududeeyo xanuunka, mana rabo inaan erayo madhan idinku dhiibo. Waan ogahay in subax kasta oo aad soo kacdaan, inuu jiro meel bannaan oo aan la buuxin karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa in mararka qaar ay jiraan fikrado culculus oo maskaxdaada ku soo dhaca, adigoo is weydiinaya haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen, ama haddii aad wax ka bedeli karteen xaaladda. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada, oo ha iga diidin inaan idin dhaho runta: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in 'markii ay u muuqatay naxariista iyo jacaylka Ilaah, badbaadadii ay timid.' Badbaadadaasi ma aha mid ku xiran waxa aynu qabanno, balse waa mid ku xiran waxa uu Ilaah inoo qabtay. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil nimcadaas ku dhex noolaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiilka ku yiri Aabbihiis riyadii uu ku arkay: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết.' Haa, Ben wuu gudbay, wuxuuna hadda joogaa meel uu nabad ku helo. Wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay kuwa Bawlos ka hadlayo, kuwaas oo sugaya 'muuqaalka ammaanta Ilaah.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, oo xasuusanaya xiriirka adiga iyo Ben idin ka dhaxeeyay, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha horay u qaadaan, inaad ku raaxaysataan waxyaabaha yaryar ee quruxda badan, sababtoo ah Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada ciyaarayeen ama ay wada safrayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Sidee buu kanu hadda u taabanayaa qof kasta oo naga mid ah oo maanta halkan jooga? Adiga oo hooyo ah oo habeenkii ilmaynaysa, adiga oo aabbe ah oo xasuusanaya sheekooyinka uu Ben si dhab ah u dhagaysan jiray, adiga oo ah qof dareemaya inuu culaysku ka batay—ogow in Rabbigu uu kula socdo. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin qaabka sacramental-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruuxa. Waxaan ku duubayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhowro, oo ha idinku rido nabaddiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo jeer.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu soo dhiibeynaa nafta Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, inuu nabad iyo iftiin ku dhex helo gacmahaaga.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu soo dhiibeynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, in naxariistaada aad ku qaboojiso qalbigooda oo aad u dhiibto rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Gacaliye: Xusuusi inay u hoggaansamaan madaxda iyo maamullada, inay adeecaan, inay diyaar u ahaadaan hawl kasta oo wanaagsan. Inayna qofna xaman, inay nabdoonaadaan, inay tixgeliyaan, oo ay naxariis u muujiyaan qof kasta. Waayo, innaga qudheennu mar baan ahayn kuwa nacas ah, caasi ah, marin-habaabsan, addoommo u ah rabitaanno iyo raaxaysiyo kala duwan, annagoo ku dhex nool xaasidnimo iyo nacayb, annagoo is-naca. Laakiin markii ay u muuqatay naxariista iyo jacaylka Ilaaha Badbaadiyeheenna ah, ma aha camal wanaagsan oo aynu qabannay awgiis, balse waa naxariistiisa awgeed, wuu inoo badbaadiyay maydhashada dib-u-dhalashada iyo cusboonaysiinta Ruuxa Quduuska ah, kaas oo uu si hodan ah inagu dul shubay Ciise Masiix oo Badbaadiyeheenna ah, si aynu nimcadiisa ugu xaq-dhowno oo aynu u noqonno dhaxaltooyo rajo leh oo nolol weligeed ah.

Daaqsin cagaaran ayuu igu dejiyay; biyo deggan ayuu ii hoggaamiyaa; naftayda ayuu soo nooleeyaa. R. Rabbigu waa daajiyahayga; waxba iima dhimna. Wuxuu igu hoggaamiyaa waddooyin toosan magiciisa aawadiis. In kasta oo aan maro dooxada mugdiga ah, cabsi xumaan ma qabo; waayo adiga ayaa igu ag sugan. Ushaada iyo budadaada ayaa i qalbi-qaboojiya. R. Rabbigu waa daajiyahayga; waxba iima dhimna. Waxaad miis ii hor dhigtaa hortooda cadaawayaashayda; madaxayga saliid ayaad ku subkaysaa; koobkayguna wuu buuxdhaafaa. R. Rabbigu waa daajiyahayga; waxba iima dhimna. Kaliya wanaag iyo naxariis ayaa i raaca cimrigayga oo dhan; waxaana ku dhex noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga sannado badan. R. Rabbigu waa daajiyahayga; waxba iima dhimna.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii uu Ciise u socday Yeruusaalem, wuxuu maray Samaariya iyo Galili. Markii uu galay tuulo, toban nin oo bukooday ayaa kula kulmay. Waxay taagnaayeen meel fog, waxayna kor u qayliyeen iyagoo leh, 'Ciise, Macallimow! Naxariiso noo yeelo!' Markuu arkay, wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Taga oo naftiinna u muujiya wadaaddada.' Intay socdeen, way bogsadeen. Mid ka mid ah, markuu gartay inuu bogsaday, wuxuu ku soo noqday isagoo Ilaah ku ammaanaya cod dheer, wuxuuna ku dhacay cagaha Ciise, wuxuuna u mahadceliyay. Wuxuu ahaa nin Samaariyaan ah. Ciise wuxuu ku jawaabay, 'Toban ayaa la bogsiiyay, miyaanay ahayn? Meeye sagaalkii kale? Ma jiro mid kale oo shisheeye ah oo ku soo noqday inuu Ilaah u mahadceliyo?' Markaasuu ku yidhi, 'Kac oo tag; iimaankaagu wuu ku badbaadiyay.'

day: Memorial of Saint Martin of Tours, Bishop

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
